title: Cosmopsychism needs no bottom level of reality

statements.text: Panpsychism presupposes fundamentalism, a bottom level of physical ultimates, and is false if matter or phenomenal properties decompose without end, which Schaffer argues is possible and some physicists take seriously. Cosmopsychism attributes basic consciousness to the cosmos at the top level, so whether there is a bottom level is irrelevant to it.

sources.quote: the falsity of fundamentalism also entails the falsity of panpsychism because, again, panpsychism presupposes fundamentalism
Whether or not there is a bottom level, therefore, is irrelevant to the cogency of priority cosmopsychism.
